newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Res unit in HK$550-850 mln offer.
newsitem.headline: China Res unit in HK$550-850 mln offer.

text.p: China Resources Enterprise Ltd said on Thursday a proposed separate listing of its China property arm China Resources Beijing Land Ltd in Hong Kong was expected to raise about HK$550 million to HK$850 million.

China Resources Enterprise said China Resources Beijing Land would issue new shares, representing about 25 percent of the expanded share capital, by way of a public offer in Hong Kong and an international placing.
An over-allotment option will also be granted to the underwriters to require the company to issue up to an additional 15 percent of the number of new shares in the proposal, it said.
The issue price of the new shares will be determined by underwriters with reference to the market demand for the shares and other details of the share offer are to be finalised, the statement said.
China Resouces Enterprise will remain the majority shareholder of China Resources Beijing Land after the share offer, it said.
Anglo Chinese has been appointed as the sponsor, joint lead manager and lead underwriter of the issue, which is co-sponsored by Credit Lyonnais Securities (Asia) Ltd and Morgan Stanley Asia Ltd.
